performance.verdict: Paid is fully dark; only GBP carried this account and it just went silent.

findings.text: Zero spend and zero leads across all 28 days — both Meta and Google Ads are fully paused; $0 invested, $0 returned.
GBP actions dropped to 0 for the last 11 consecutive days (Sep 29–Sep 8); prior 17 days averaged ~1.8 actions/day — listing engagement has gone dark.
GA4 sessions fell 32.2% week-over-week; last 3 days averaged 4 sessions vs prior 3-day average of ~14 — organic traffic is in confirmed decline.
GHL pipeline data is null — with 201 sessions over 28 days and 0 GHL records, intake tracking is either broken or disconnected entirely.

suggestions.text: Audit GBP listing immediately — 11 straight zero-action days after ~1.8/day baseline signals a suspension, penalty, or listing issue.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped from a ~1.8/day average to zero for 11 consecutive days ending Sep 8. Check Google Business Profile for suspension notices, ownership conflicts, or listing suppression. Success is confirmed when daily GBP actions return to ≥1/day. Re-check by Sep 12.

suggestions.text: Verify GHL pipeline connection — 201 sessions and 0 pipeline records over 28 days indicates intake tracking is broken, not just slow.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows null pipeline data despite 201 GA4 sessions in the last 28 days and 0 paid or organic leads recorded. Check the GHL form embed, webhook, or CRM integration for breaks. Success is a non-null pipeline count with at least one opportunity logged. Re-check by Sep 12.

suggestions.text: Hold any paid reactivation until GBP and GHL fixes confirm organic floor is intact — no budget to diagnose against.
suggestions.monday_update: All paid channels have been at $0 spend for the full 28-day window. Reactivating before GBP visibility and GHL intake are restored means buying traffic into a broken funnel. Watch GA4 sessions trend and GBP actions; if both recover by Sep 16, escalate to Sohib for paid relaunch discussion.
